role_description: Takes the classified query and intent, searches a FAISS vector knowledge base, and returns grounded context documents. This is where hallucination is either prevented or introduced — retrieval quality determines downstream faithfulness.

output_schema.retrieved_docs: array — list of {content, title, category, doc_id, score}
output_schema.citations: array of strings — document titles used
output_schema.retrieval_scores: array of floats — similarity scores per retrieved doc
output_schema.retrieval_query: string — the augmented query sent to the vector store

system_prompt_summary: Retrieval node. Augments query with intent label, searches FAISS index, returns top-K grounded documents.
constraints: Must return only documents from the knowledge base — no hallucinated content
Must prefix retrieval query with intent label for intent-aware search
eval_focus: Retrieval precision — are returned docs relevant to the query?
Faithfulness — does retrieved content actually answer the question?
Hallucination rate — does the agent fabricate document content?
